dualConfigMode.supportedStatus: UNVERIFIED_PENDING_ADMIN_ROUND_TRIP — precedence is UNRESOLVED_01; the generator MUST emit a single explicit mode and MUST NOT default to dual
dualConfigMode.corpusPrevalence: 24/30 themes (80.0%) maintain both config/settings.html and config/settings_schema.json
dualConfigMode.precedenceRule: config/settings.html provides legacy Admin theme settings form; config/settings_schema.json provides visual editor schema and attribute bindings. Precedence between the two on colliding setting ids is NOT established.
dualConfigMode.dualEmissionInvariant: If a hand-authored theme ships both declaration files, they MUST declare the same setting ids with the same defaults and config/settings_data.json MUST carry those defaults, so no precedence order can change rendered output.

rules: Pure HTML only — NO Liquid tags allowed.
Use compact single-line <tr> table layout inside <fieldset>.
Wrap nested fieldsets inside <div class='ml-5'> because Haravan strips class attributes from <fieldset> elements.
Use special input classes: class='color' for color picker, class='linklist' for menu select, class='collection' for collection select, class='blog' for blog select, class='page' for page select.
File upload inputs must carry target file extension in name attribute: <input type='file' name='logo.png'>.
Explicit visibility checkbox required for every optional section or group.

domBindings.mappingRule: Every merchant setting in schema must be bound on rendered HTML with both setting-id matching the schema id and setting-type matching the schema type (image_picker maps to image).
domBindings.exemptionRule: Do not annotate hidden layout wrappers, link-only settings, or data-only metadata tags.

conventions.precompilation: Haravan runtime automatically compiles *.scss.liquid and *.css.liquid into *.css CDN assets.

dependencyPolicy.coreFramework: Zero-dependency Vanilla JS and native CSS. No hard dependency on jQuery, Bootstrap, or Tailwind runtime.

carouselPolicy.corePrimitive: Native CSS scroll-snap container with touch gestures and Vanilla JS navigation controls (<2KB).
carouselPolicy.vendorLibraryHandling: Slick Slider (19/30 themes), Swiper JS (9/30 themes), Owl Carousel (6/30 themes), and Flickity (5/30 themes) are categorized as Project Theme extensions. Base Theme Core does not ship vendor carousel libraries to avoid jQuery bloat and CLS regressions.

scriptLoadingPolicy.mainThemeBundle: Loaded with 'defer' attribute at the end of snippets/footer-scripts.liquid before </body>.
scriptLoadingPolicy.inlinedScript: Strictly limited to critical DOM theme tokens and feature detection in <head>.

styleConventions.tokens: CSS Custom Properties declared on :root at the top of assets/theme.css.
styleConventions.layoutSystem: Responsive container system (.container, .grid, .flex) without monolithic external frameworks.
styleConventions.reducedMotion: Mandatory @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block disabling smooth scrolling and animations.

imagePolicy.masterPresetRule: Avoid unbounded 'master' filter; always select bounded dimensions matching responsive display slots.
imagePolicy.loadingAttribute: loading='eager' and fetchpriority='high' on first-viewport LCP images; loading='lazy' on all below-the-fold images.

rules.rationale: Prevents stored XSS injection from administrative settings fields.

rules.example: {{ product.title | escape }}, {{ collection.title | escape }}, {{ article.title | escape }}
rules.rationale: Escapes quotes, ampersands, and angle brackets inside HTML contexts.

rules.context: URLs inside href and src attributes
rules.rationale: Ensures clean attribute values and prevents attribute breakout.
Prevents broken HTML tags when product titles contain double quotation marks.
Strips rich text tags before truncating to prevent unclosed HTML element leaks.
Sanitizes tab headings extracted from product.metafields.hrvptabs.tabs.
Merchant-authored WYSIWYG markup sanitized by Haravan Core at input time; applying escape would render raw HTML tags to the consumer.
DotLiquid json filter produces safe JSON serialization without manual string concatenation.

unresolved.title: Admin Settings Format Precedence (settings.html vs settings_schema.json)
unresolved.description: Corpus census reveals that 24/30 themes maintain both config/settings.html (pure HTML table form) and config/settings_schema.json (F1GENZ JSON schema). Haravan Admin round-trip saving behavior when both files define overlapping keys is not documented in official manuals.
unresolved.blocking: Phase 05 Generator Cutover & Phase 06 Base Theme Assembly: blocks decision on whether generator must emit dual config (settings.html + settings_schema.json) or single schema format for unpublished test themes.
unresolved.investigationPlan: Execute isolated test push on staging theme 1001512581 with distinct test values in settings.html vs settings_schema.json, perform Admin GUI save, and probe rendered output in settings_data.json.

unresolved.title: Storefront Theme Identity Attestation Mechanism via Browser DOM / HTTP
unresolved.description: Historical test artifacts relied on Shopify ?preview_theme_id= parameter which was completely inert on unauthenticated storefront GETs, causing tests to measure the live theme (Defect D9). While ?themeid= is verified to trigger a different HTML response and set the preview_theme_id cookie, HTTP cookies and HTML equality alone do not provide a cryptographically verifiable DOM watermark proving exactly which theme rendered.
unresolved.blocking: Phase 03 Capture Identity & Phase 07 Storefront Verification Campaign: blocks automated verification gate from declaring a definitive VERIFIED_PASS without explicit theme attestation marker.
unresolved.investigationPlan: Inject a deterministic meta watermark (<meta name='haravan-theme-identity' content='theme-id:commit-sha'>) into Base Theme layout/theme.liquid and have Playwright verify this DOM marker before capturing screenshots.

unresolved.title: Menu REST API Missing Resource Alternative
unresolved.description: Store inventory audit confirmed that Omni REST API endpoint /web/link_lists.json returns 404. There is currently no verified REST API endpoint to programmatically inspect or provision navigation linklists on Haravan.
unresolved.blocking: Phase 08B Automated Fixture Provisioning: blocks automated creation of custom navigation menus via REST scripts; requires fallback to manual admin menu configuration or fallback settings handle binding.
unresolved.investigationPlan: Probe Haravan Commerce GraphQL API and internal Haraweb admin endpoints to determine if menu management is exposed via private GraphQL queries.

unresolved.title: Product Media Object Availability Boundary
unresolved.description: Haravan 1.0 standard relies exclusively on product.images and product.featured_image. Some newer Haravan themes report support for product.media (supporting 3D models and video). Whether all Haravan store tiers support product.media at runtime is unknown.
unresolved.blocking: Phase 06 Base Theme Product Template: blocks decision on whether to implement gallery using product.images (100% universal compatibility) or product.media.
unresolved.investigationPlan: Probe product Liquid object on store phukienmaymoc.com to check if product.media is defined and populated for products with video media.

unresolved.title: Sentinel -1 Semantics in Historical Canary Safety Allowlist
unresolved.description: Historical file .canary/state/subset-r2.json:39-43 whitelisted theme ID '-1', causing safety guards to pass-open and observe the live theme while recording themeid=-1 (Defect D11). Exact historical intent (uninitialized variable vs deliberate wildcard) is unverified.
unresolved.blocking: Phase 01 Fail-closed Adjudication: blocks historical telemetry parsing from treating -1 records as valid test runs.
unresolved.investigationPlan: Enforce strict positive integer regular expression for themeId in all verifier guards, rejecting -1 with FAIL_CLOSED_SAFETY_ABORT.

unresolved.title: Newsletter Subscription Form Mechanism
unresolved.description: snippets/footer.liquid posts the newsletter field to /account/contact with form_type=customer and contact[tags]=newsletter. The `customer` form type is not in the documented Haravan form-type list (contact, customer_login, create_customer, reset_customer_password, activate_customer_password) recorded in docs/haravan/routes-and-handles.md, and no corpus theme was measured using it. The raw POST markup is what the implementation ships.
unresolved.blocking: Phase 06 Base Theme: the newsletter block is not certified to store an address anywhere. It must not be presented as a verified subscription feature until a live round-trip observes where the address lands.
unresolved.investigationPlan: Submit the form once against the unpublished staging theme (1001512581) with a controlled address, observe the HTTP response and whether a Haravan customer/contact record appears, then either confirm the endpoint or replace the block with a documented mechanism.
